title: What the Memory Fabric is
description: The fabric is memory with layers: a fast index layer for instant lookup, a summary layer for compressed knowledge, a record layer for full persistent entries, and a source layer holding originals. Items move between layers based on measured access patterns, and every layer links down to the original so nothing is ever just a floating summary.

title: Promotion and demotion algorithm
description: Items earn their layer: frequently accessed summaries get promoted toward the index, untouched records cool toward deep storage, and anything whose source is questioned gets quarantined regardless of heat. Promotion uses measured access counts and recency, never guesses, and every move is logged for audit.

title: Summary generation algorithm
description: Summaries are generated from records with fidelity targets: each summary must preserve the record's key claims and link to the full record for the rest. Fidelity is measured by claim-retention checks, and summaries below target are regenerated or escalated to human review instead of shipping thin.

description: Callers ask the fabric for knowledge, not layers: give me what you know about X, at a chosen fidelity and latency budget. title: Reasoning: consistency across layers
description: Layers can disagree — a stale summary contradicting its record. The fabric runs consistency checks: summaries must entail their records' key claims, index entries must resolve to live items. Inconsistencies trigger re-derivation, and until fixed, the fabric serves the lower layer with a staleness note.
